title: RemoveMemberFlow
wrapsNative: MonarchBottomSheet with dismissible = false while busy holding MonarchAssigneePicker, MonarchCheckboxRow, MonarchMemberRow, MonarchConsequenceList and MonarchButtons; androidx.compose.material3.SnackbarHostState.showSnackbar with MonarchSnackbarHost for Undo
summary: A recipe, not a component: remove a member from a workspace in two steps, handing over their open work to other members (all at once or per kind of work) and then confirming with the consequences listed, followed by an Undo snackbar.
whenToUse: When an admin removes someone who may still own open work: issues, tasks, documents or deals that would otherwise be left without an owner.
whenNotToUse: For someone who owns nothing, a confirm dialog (MonarchDialog) is enough. For a member leaving on their own, use the LeaveWorkspaceFlow recipe. For many members at once, use the BulkDestructiveFlow recipe.
api: @Composable fun MonarchBottomSheet(onDismissRequest: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, description: String? = null, dismissible: Boolean = true, showHandle: Boolean = true, fullyExpanded: Boolean = true, fullWidthContent: Boolean = false, content: @Composable MonarchBottomSheetScope.() -> Unit)

@Composable fun MonarchAssigneePicker(people: List<MonarchAssigneePerson>, selected: String?, onSelectedChange: (String?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, …, allowUnassigned: Boolean = true, …, labels: MonarchAssigneePickerLabels = MonarchAssigneePickerLabels())
@Composable fun MonarchCheckboxRow(checked: Boolean, onCheckedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, description: String? = null)
@Composable public fun MonarchMemberRow(name: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, image: Painter? = null, email: String? = null, …)
@Composable fun MonarchConsequenceList(items: List<MonarchConsequence>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, …)
suspend fun SnackbarHostState.showSnackbar(message: String, actionLabel: String? = null, withDismissAction: Boolean = false, duration: SnackbarDuration = …): SnackbarResult

states.name: reassign
states.description: Shown only when the member owns open work: one MonarchAssigneePicker for all of it, the kinds of work listed, and a checkbox to choose a person for each kind instead.

states.name: per item
states.description: One MonarchAssigneePicker per kind of work, labelled with its count, each starting from the all-at-once choice.

states.name: confirm
states.description: The member as a MonarchMemberRow and the consequences: they lose access, where each kind of work goes or that it is left unassigned, and that their past activity stays.

states.name: removing
states.description: Remove member shows progress and the sheet cannot be swiped away.

states.name: failed
states.description: A danger MonarchInlineNotice above the buttons; the sheet stays on the confirm step.

states.name: removed
states.description: The sheet closes and a snackbar says the member was removed, with Undo.

appearance: A Material 3 bottom sheet in the colors Monarch maps to the scheme, holding Monarch parts: headings and body text, assignee pickers, a checkbox row, a member row, a consequence list with its kind colors and a danger button. The snackbar uses MonarchSnackbarHost. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web's RemoveMemberFlow is one component built on WizardDialog with a step-up authentication option, number formatting and a useUndoToast bridge. On Android it is a recipe, as the native-first rule asks for a flow of this kind: a MonarchBottomSheet with two steps instead of a wizard dialog, MonarchAssigneePicker for the hand-over, and the Material 3 snackbar for Undo. The app writes the strings with plurals resources, runs re-authentication (for example BiometricPrompt, which needs androidx.biometric in the app) before the removal, and sends the reassignments to its server. dismissible = false keeps the sheet open while removing. iOS has no entry for this id yet.
accessibility: The title and each step's heading are headings (MonarchTextStyle.Title and Heading).
Each MonarchAssigneePicker is named by its label: Reassign all open work to, or the count and kind of work.
MonarchConsequenceList reads each consequence with its kind, so where the work goes does not depend on color.
Remove member is a danger MonarchButton that reports its busy state while removing.
The Undo snackbar is announced by the system and Undo is reachable by TalkBack.
edgeCases: Skip the reassign step when the member owns nothing: start on the confirm step.
Leave the removed member out of the people offered in the pickers.
Turning on per item copies the all-at-once choice into each picker, so nothing is lost.
Reset the choices each time the sheet opens.
If the removal fails, keep the choices and show the error on the confirm step.
